gloss: at that time, in those days

definitions.gloss: at that time, in those days
definitions.explanation: Refers to a specific period in the past that has been mentioned or is understood from context.

examples.japanese: {当時|とうじ}、{私|わたし}は{学生|がくせい}でした。
examples.english: At that time, I was a student.

examples.japanese: {当時|とうじ}の{写真|しゃしん}を{見|み}せてください。
examples.english: Please show me photos from that time.

examples.japanese: {当時|とうじ}は{大変|たいへん}でした。

notes:
{当時|とうじ} refers to a specific time in the past.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {当時|とうじ}の + noun (~ of that time)
- {当時|とうじ}は (at that time)
- {当時|とうじ}から (since that time)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- その{頃|ころ}/{時|とき}: at that time (casual)
- {当時|とうじ}: at that time (slightly formal)
- あの{頃|ころ}: in those days (nostalgic)

[Register: Neutral to Formal]
